values.note: One restroom with showers serves the loop. The dump station is for registered campers and dump-pass holders.

values.note: 'WE CANNOT TAKE RESERVATIONS. RESERVATIONS CAN ONLY BE MADE THROUGH Recreation.gov.' 14 consecutive nights, 14 in any rolling 30. A 1-night minimum is marked soft. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 3 p.m.

values.note: 26 campsites (21 RV electric, 1 RV non-electric, 1 standard non-electric, 3 tent-only) plus 4 cabins. Permitted RV/trailer length runs 20 to 40 ft by site (three electric sites cap at 20 ft); sites 19-23 are pull-through. Overhead power-line clearance on the camp road is 13 ft 4 in.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A10122722 (site types, permitted equipment max length, Driveway Entry) + notice ('Overhead powerlines clearance is 13'4"'), read 2026-10-20

note: USACE campground on a wooded hillside near East Branch Clarion River Lake (Pittsburgh District). Reservable on recreation.gov only; 21 30-amp electric RV sites, 2 non-electric and 3 tent-only sites plus 4 cabins. Steep terrain; recreation.gov allows RVs of 20-40 ft depending on the site, five pull-throughs; 13'4" powerline clearance on the camp road. Not lakefront. --Claude
